description.zh: 米尔福德峡湾是新西兰峡湾国家公园的核心景观，被鲁德亚德·吉卜林誉为「世界第八大奇迹」。垂直峭壁从海面直插云端，米特峰高达1,692米，雨后百瀑悬挂，气势磅礴。
description.en: Milford Sound — Rudyard Kipling's 'Eighth Wonder of the World' — is the centrepiece of Fiordland NP. Sheer cliffs plunge from 1,692 m Mitre Peak straight into the sea; after rain, hundreds of waterfalls appear.

zh: 世界遗产
峡湾
自然奇观
en: UNESCO
Fiord
Natural Wonder

zh: 米尔福德峡湾：被称为「世界第八大奇迹」
迈特峰（Mitre Peak）垂直从海面升起1,692米
全年降雨量极高，峡湾内有无数临时瀑布
en: Called the 'Eighth Wonder of the World'
Mitre Peak rises 1,692 m vertically from the fjord
Year-round high rainfall creates hundreds of temporary waterfalls after rain

duration.zh: 一天（含奥克兰/皇后镇驾车）

tips.zh: 下雨天反而是峡湾最美的时候，瀑布数量倍增。从皇后镇驾车约4小时，建议清晨出发。
tips.en: Rain actually makes Milford Sound more spectacular — waterfalls multiply dramatically. Drive from Queenstown (about 4 hours) — leave at dawn for the best experience.

description.zh: 霍比特村是彼得·杰克逊《指环王》和《霍比特人》系列电影的拍摄地，位于新西兰北岛的马塔马塔农场。44座圆门霍比特洞穴和「绿龙酒馆」让影迷得以亲历中土世界。
description.en: Hobbiton is the filming location for Peter Jackson's Lord of the Rings and Hobbit trilogies, set on a Matamata farm on New Zealand's North Island. Its 44 hobbit holes and the Green Dragon Inn bring Middle-earth to life.

zh: 电影取景地
霍比特人
主题观光
en: Film Location
Hobbit
Theme Tour

location.zh: 怀卡托大区马塔马塔，新西兰北岛
location.en: Matamata, Waikato, North Island, New Zealand

zh: 《指环王》和《霍比特人》电影取景地，完全按比例建造的霍比特人村
37个霍比特人洞穴门、磨坊和绿龙酒馆一应俱全
位于怀托摩附近的私人农场，只能通过官方导览参观
en: Filming location for The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit trilogies
37 Hobbit holes, a mill, the Green Dragon Inn — all full-scale
Private farm near Matamata; accessible only by official guided tour

admission.zh: 约约99新西兰元（导览约2小时）

tips.zh: 必须提前在官网预约，经常售罄；可在奥克兰和怀托摩萤火虫洞之间安排为一日联游。
tips.en: Book in advance on the official website — tours sell out. Easily combined with Auckland and the Waitomo Glowworm Caves in a single day trip.

description.zh: 皇后镇被誉为「世界探险之都」，是蹦极跳、跳伞、喷射快艇、滑雪等极限运动的发源地或集中地。瓦卡蒂普湖畔依山傍水的小镇风光与壮阔的雪山景观相互映衬，四季皆宜。
description.en: Queenstown is the 'Adventure Capital of the World' — the birthplace of commercial bungee jumping and a hub for skydiving, jet-boating and skiing. Set on Lake Wakatipu beneath snowy peaks, it is superb year-round.

zh: 探险运动
蹦极
滑雪
en: Adventure Sports
Bungee Jumping
Skiing

location.zh: 奥塔哥大区，新西兰南岛
location.en: Otago region, South Island, New Zealand

zh: 世界冒险运动之都：蹦极、跳伞、急流泛舟一应俱全
瓦卡提普湖（Lake Wakatipu）和雷马克布尔山（Remarkables）的壮美风景
周边通往峡湾国家公园、阿斯帕林山的徒步路线
en: World adventure capital: bungy jumping, skydiving and whitewater rafting
Lake Wakatipu and The Remarkables mountain range — spectacular scenery
Gateway to Fiordland National Park and Mount Aspiring treks

admission.zh: 城区免费，冒险项目约100—300新西兰元

tips.zh: 皇后镇全年可游，夏（12—2月）徒步、冬（6—8月）滑雪；餐厅价格较贵，可自购超市食品节省开支。
tips.en: Queenstown is good year-round: summer (Dec–Feb) for hiking, winter (Jun–Aug) for skiing. Restaurants are pricey; buying groceries cuts costs significantly.

description.zh: 海湾群岛位于新西兰北岛最北端，由144座岛屿组成，是帆船、海豚共游、钓鱼和深潜的天堂。怀唐伊条约签署地——怀唐伊Treaty Grounds也位于此处，是新西兰最重要的历史遗址。
description.en: The Bay of Islands comprises 144 islands at the tip of New Zealand's North Island — paradise for sailing, swimming with dolphins, fishing and diving. Waitangi Treaty Grounds, NZ's most important historic site, stands here.

zh: 海湾
历史遗址
海洋活动
en: Bay
Historic Site
Water Activities

location.en: Northland region, North Island, New Zealand

zh: 144座岛屿组成的海湾，新西兰最重要的历史地区之一
威唐伊条约地（Waitangi Treaty Grounds）是新西兰建国的象征
海豚共游、深海钓鱼和独木舟是当地主要活动
en: Bay dotted with 144 islands; one of New Zealand's most historically significant regions
Waitangi Treaty Grounds — where the nation was founded in 1840
Dolphin swimming, game fishing and kayaking the main activities

admission.zh: 威唐伊条约地约35新西兰元

tips.zh: 从奥克兰驾车约3小时，是北岛最佳的周末度假目的地；2月份的威唐伊日（新西兰国庆日）有特别庆典活动。
tips.en: About 3 hours' drive from Auckland — a classic North Island weekend getaway. Waitangi Day (6 February) brings special ceremonies and cultural performances.

name.zh: 怀塔基白石UNESCO世界地质公园

description.zh: 怀塔基白石地质公园位于新西兰南岛东岸，面积7,214平方公里，是大洋洲唯一的UNESCO世界地质公园，于2023年5月获得认定。公园以壮观的石灰岩地貌、冰川峡谷和海洋化石著称，为揭示地球第八大洲「西兰蒂亚」（Zealandia/Te Riu-a-Māui）的形成历史提供了独一无二的地质证据。
description.en: The Waitaki Whitestone Geopark on New Zealand's South Island east coast spans 7,214 km² and is Australasia's only UNESCO Global Geopark, designated in May 2023. It is celebrated for spectacular limestone karst landscapes, glacial valleys and marine fossils, offering unparalleled evidence of the formation of Zealandia — Earth's eighth continent.

zh: 地质公园
石灰岩地貌
西兰蒂亚
en: UNESCO Geopark
Limestone Karst
Zealandia

location.zh: 奥塔哥大区，新西兰南岛东岸，怀塔基河流域
location.en: Waitaki District, east coast South Island, New Zealand

zh: 联合国教科文组织全球地质公园（2023年），大洋洲唯一
莫拉基巨砾（Moeraki Boulders）和大象岩（Elephant Rocks）等标志性地质奇观
揭示西兰蒂亚大陆从冈瓦纳超大陆分离、沉没又隆升的完整地质史
en: UNESCO Global Geopark since 2023 — the only one in Australasia
Iconic landmarks including the Moeraki Boulders and Elephant Rocks limestone formations
Reveals the full geological story of Zealandia — from Gondwana breakup to ocean submersion and re-emergence

tips.zh: 从达尼丁（Dunedin）驾车约1.5小时可达；奥马鲁（Oamaru）是探索公园的最佳基地，当地有维多利亚时代建筑群和蓝眼企鹅保护区，是不可错过的额外体验。
tips.en: About 1.5 hours' drive from Dunedin. Oamaru is the ideal base — its Victorian limestone precinct and blue penguin colony are not to be missed alongside the geopark geology.
